title: Disabled links lack tabindex='-1'
finding: Disabled role and org links remained focusable via Tab despite aria-disabled='true'.
notes: Added tabindex='-1' via UserAttributes when _canSwitchRole/_canSwitchOrg is false; added bUnit test DisabledLinks_HaveTabindexMinusOne_AndSkipMenuAttributes.

title: No test asserts specific spec aria-label strings
finding: Existing tests covered presence of aria-label but not the exact sentence strings the spec enumerates.
notes: Added bUnit test Links_ExposeSpecSentenceAriaLabels asserting the three exact strings: 'Casey Hart, sign out', 'System Admin, switch role', 'Internal Operations, switch organization'.

title: No aria-haspopup on menu-trigger links
finding: Screen readers may not announce role/org links as menu buttons if MudBlazor does not inject aria-haspopup on ActivatorContent.
notes: Added aria-haspopup='menu' on enabled role and org links via UserAttributes; added bUnit test EnabledMenuLinks_AdvertisePopup.

title: title tooltip not accessible on touch devices
finding: Native title attribute does not surface on touch. aria-label already contains full text for AT users, but touch sighted users see only the truncated value.
notes: Inherent limitation of the title approach. aria-label already covers AT users. A full MudTooltip solution would add DOM complexity without a proportional benefit for this single sentence. Revisit only if UAT flags it.
